weights: row weight 1 / (snapshots of its scene in the training fold * 4), then scaled to mean 1 over the training rows; the same rows and weights for every model
decision_rule: R5 if score > 0, otherwise Continue (a score of exactly 0 is Continue). 0 is the net-gain boundary, not a harm tolerance; no risk constraint is claimed.

candidates.M_Q_full: 568 standardised policy_feature + checkpoint one-hot; two binary heads; score = q_R - q_C
candidates.M_pair_full: same input; multinomial over the four joint outcomes; score = p(Rescue) - p(Harm)

input_of_the_candidates.order: StandardScaler(policy_feature, all 568 dimensions) -> append checkpoint one-hot [12, 52, 92, 132]
input_of_the_candidates.fit_on: unique training snapshots of the fold only

changed_against_stage3a.stage3a: StandardScaler(policy_feature) -> PCA(8) -> StandardScaler(PC scores) -> append checkpoint one-hot [12, 52, 92, 132]
changed_against_stage3a.stage3b: model input: all 568 saved policy_feature dimensions, standardised on the unique training snapshots of the fold, plus the checkpoint one-hot; no PCA

note: standardising 568 dimensions instead of 8 components also changes the geometry of the L2 penalty; a difference in results is not evidence that the PCA was the cause of the Stage 3A result
